subject: Re: Order Form amendment — add 2k GPU hours & price adjustment
messages:
From: David Lee <david.lee@optum.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Torres <sara.torres@optum.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: increase Order Form capacity + confirmation of price impact

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the pilot — the team is seeing steady growth and we need to add capacity for July. Attached is a quick workbook outlining our request: add 2,000 GPU hours (p50 estimate), shift 60% of traffic to a dedicated pool during peak window, and the expected monthly token volume.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can you accommodate the incremental capacity starting July 1?
- What is the one-time implementation fee and the delta to the monthly committed fee?
- Any required MSA exhibit or Order Form edits we should expect?

We need a rough commercial response by EOD Thursday so procurement can budget. I can loop procurement if helpful.

Attachments: [Optum_capacity_add_request.xlsx (xlsx)]

Best,
David
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Optum Solutions

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: David Lee <david.lee@optum.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: increase Order Form capacity + confirmation of price impact

David — thanks for the workbook, and congrats on the growth. High-level plan below so you have something to share with procurement immediately. Mina (Legal) and Karthik (Commercial) are on copy.

Quick answers:
- Target start: we have availability to provision a dedicated burst pool effective July 1 if we sign the amendment by June 25.
- One-time implementation estimate: $9,500 (approx — includes reserved slot provisioning and runbook updates).
- Monthly committed fee delta: +18% on top of your current monthly commitment for the added 2k GPU hours; we can provide a tiered rate if you prefer a 6‑month smoothing.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood to issue a proposed amendment (Order Form + short MSA exhibit) by Wed EOD (attached draft).
2) Optum to review redlines and return to Redwood by Fri COB (so Legal can triage).
3) Signatures via DocuSign by June 28 to hit July 1 provisioning.

I attached a first-pass Order Form and a redline placeholder for MSA exhibit that Mina can refine. If procurement needs a PO-first flow, tell me who the contact is and we will accept the PO but will still require the signed amendment.

Attachments: [orderform_proposed_v3.docx, redwood_redline_msa_v2-OPT.pdf]

—
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@optum.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: increase Order Form capacity + confirmation of price impact

Priya / Karthik — I skimmed the draft and flagged a few legal items for Optum to consider. I included inline comments in the PDF redline but summarize below so we keep the thread concise.

Key points for Optum to confirm:
- SLA & ramp: the amendment currently references a 99.5% monthly availability SLA; if Optum requires a stricter SLA for the dedicated burst pool we need to discuss credits and operational commitments.
- Data handling: confirm the classification of data processed by the additional capacity (e.g., PHI vs. non‑PHI) — if PHI, we need the DPA addendum updated and KMS/HSM language tightened.
- Fee phasing: for commercial clarity we propose a 3-month phased billing (50%/100%/100%) to ease the operational delta; please advise if procurement cannot accept phased billing.
- Acceptance criteria: add a short ops acceptance checklist (connectivity, test harness, latency baseline) as Exhibit X to the amendment — reduces post-provision disputes.

I will prepare an edited PDF with tracked changes and a redline covering the three bullets above. Priya — if you can confirm whether Optum wants the ramp SLA tightened and whether the extra capacity will see PHI, I will finalize.

Mina Haddad
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

From: Sara Torres <sara.torres@optum.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: increase Order Form capacity + confirmation of price impact

Thanks — quick replies from procurement/legal side below. Per David and procurement lead:

- Optum confirms the workload is non‑PHI (synthetic / anonymized production telemetry), so DPA changes are not required for this add.
- Procurement accepts the 3‑month phased billing approach. Good for cashflow planning.
- SLA: procurement is comfortable with 99.5% for burst pools; however, Engineering will request a short follow-up SLO addendum later if we see latency variance during the first 30 days.

We reviewed Mina's redline and will return formal comments by Monday; in the meantime, happy to proceed with DocuSign once Redwood publishes the final amendment. Link to our procurement tracker: https://procure.optum/internal/PR-7784

Sara Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager, Optum Solutions
Sara.torres@optum.com
